windows.title: Windows
windows.description: Per-window placement persisted across sessions (position, size, state, and DPI).

userMenu.title: User Menu
userMenu.description: Settings-driven external commands for the Commands > User Menu popup and cmd/pane/userMenu/<itemId> shortcuts.

makeFileList.title: Make File List
makeFileList.description: Last selected non-default options for Commands > Make File List; missing fields load as defaults.

shortcutBinding.title: Shortcut Binding
shortcutBinding.description: Defines a single keyboard shortcut binding.

vk.title: Key
vk.description: The key name (e.g. F1, Tab, VK_2E).

commandId.title: Command
commandId.description: The command identifier (cmd/...). Use cmd/shortcut/unassigned only as the internal sentinel for an intentionally unassigned shortcut chord.

searchNameMode.title: Name Mode
searchNameMode.description: How the name pattern should be matched.

searchContentMode.title: Content Mode
searchContentMode.description: How file content should be matched.

batchRenameCaseStyle.title: Batch Rename Case Style
batchRenameCaseStyle.description: Case transformation applied by Batch Rename.

gridColumnLayoutEntry.title: Grid Column Layout Entry
gridColumnLayoutEntry.description: Persisted grid column layout entry keyed by stable column ID.

widthDip.title: Width (DIP)
widthDip.description: Persisted visible column width in device-independent pixels.

searchSettings.title: Find Dialog
searchSettings.description: Persisted Find Files and Directories dialog state.

sortColumnId.title: Results Sort Column
sortColumnId.description: Stable logical column id used for persisted Find results sorting.

sortDescending.title: Results Sort Descending
sortDescending.description: Whether the persisted Find results sort is descending.

resultsGridLayout.title: Results Grid Layout
resultsGridLayout.description: Persisted Find results-grid column order and widths.

batchRenameSettings.title: Batch Rename
batchRenameSettings.description: Persisted Batch Rename options, histories, and preview-grid state. Manual multiline names are intentionally not persisted.

flattenSeparator.title: Flatten Separator
flattenSeparator.description: Separator used when folder/path macros are flattened into leaf-name text.

previewSortColumnId.title: Preview Sort Column
previewSortColumnId.description: Stable logical column id used for persisted Batch Rename preview sorting.

previewSortDescending.title: Preview Sort Descending
previewSortDescending.description: Whether the persisted Batch Rename preview sort is descending.

previewGridLayout.title: Preview Grid Layout
previewGridLayout.description: Persisted Batch Rename preview-grid column order and widths.

shortcutsSettings.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
shortcutsSettings.description: Keyboard shortcuts configuration (Function bar and Folder view). Missing default chords are restored at startup; cmd/shortcut/unassigned persists an intentional no-op removal.

functionBar.title: Function Bar Shortcuts
functionBar.description: Shortcut bindings active when using the function bar.

folderView.title: Folder View Shortcuts
folderView.description: Shortcut bindings active when interacting with the folder view.

functionBarCollapsed.title: Function Bar Collapsed
functionBarCollapsed.description: Whether the Function Bar shortcuts group is collapsed.

folderViewCollapsed.title: Folder View Collapsed
folderViewCollapsed.description: Whether the Folder View shortcuts group is collapsed.

sortColumnId.title: Sort Column ID
sortColumnId.description: Stable logical column ID used for the persisted shortcuts sort.

sortDescending.title: Sort Descending
sortDescending.description: Whether the persisted shortcuts sort is descending.

gridLayout.title: Grid Layout
gridLayout.description: Persisted shortcuts-grid column order and widths.

fileActionsSettings.title: File Actions
fileActionsSettings.description: Actions and command associations for viewer and editor command families.

viewerFileActionsSettings.title: Viewer File Actions
viewerFileActionsSettings.description: Viewer Actions and Associations used by F3 View, Alt+F3 Alternate View, and View With.

actions.title: Viewer Actions
actions.description: Named internal viewer-plugin or external viewer actions that can be launched.

associations.title: Viewer Associations
associations.description: Rules mapping a file match and optional computer name to F3 and Alt+F3 viewer actions.

editorFileActionsSettings.title: Editor File Actions
editorFileActionsSettings.description: Editor Actions and Associations used by F4 Edit, Ctrl+Shift+F4 Alternate Edit, Shift+F4 Edit New, and Edit With.

actions.title: Editor Actions
actions.description: Named external editor actions that can be launched.

associations.title: Editor Associations
associations.description: Rules mapping a file match and optional computer name to F4, Ctrl+Shift+F4, and Shift+F4 editor actions.

viewerAssociationRule.title: Viewer Association
viewerAssociationRule.description: Associates a file match and optional computer override with primary and alternate viewer actions.

computerName.title: Computer
computerName.description: Exact computer name for an override; empty means any computer.

alternateViewActionId.title: Alt+F3 Alternate View
alternateViewActionId.description: Action ID used by cmd/pane/alternateView; empty means none.

editorAssociationRule.title: Editor Association
editorAssociationRule.description: Associates a file match and optional computer override with edit, alternate edit, and edit-new actions.

computerName.title: Computer
computerName.description: Exact computer name for an override; empty means any computer.

alternateEditActionId.title: Ctrl+Shift+F4 Alternate Edit
alternateEditActionId.description: Action ID used by cmd/pane/alternateEdit; empty means none.

editNewActionId.title: Shift+F4 Edit New
editNewActionId.description: Action ID offered by cmd/pane/editNew after creating a new file; empty means none.

fileActionMatch.title: File Match
fileActionMatch.description: Default, extension, or filename-pattern match used by file action applicability and associations.

value.title: Match Value
value.description: Extension with leading dot or filename glob; empty for default.

fileActionApplicability.title: Applicability
fileActionApplicability.description: Optional file and computer filters for a configured action.

matches.title: File Matches
matches.description: Allowed file matches for this action; empty means any file.

computerNames.title: Computers
computerNames.description: Computer names where this action applies; empty means any computer.

makeFileListSettings.title: Make File List
makeFileListSettings.description: Persists non-default last-used source, format, output, field, and macro options for cmd/pane/makeFileList; missing fields load as defaults.

sourceMode.title: Source
sourceMode.description: selection uses selected items or the focused item; currentFolder enumerates the active folder contents.

recursive.title: Recursive
recursive.description: Include child folders when the source contains folders.

format.title: Format
format.description: Output format for the generated list.

outputTarget.title: Output Target
outputTarget.description: Write the generated list to the clipboard or to outputFile.

textMacro.title: Text Macro
textMacro.description: Text-format row template. Supported macros include {filename}, {name}, {fullPath}, {path}, {size}, {modified}, {attributes}, and {isDirectory}.

outputFile.title: Output File
outputFile.description: Destination path used when outputTarget is file.

fileActionDefinition.title: File Action
fileActionDefinition.description: Named internal viewer-plugin or external program action used by file commands.

displayName.description: User-facing action label shown in picker menus and preferences.

enabled.description: Disabled actions remain in settings but are not executable.

kind.description: viewerPlugin opens an internal viewer plugin; externalProgram launches a configured process.

pluginId.description: Viewer plugin ID used when kind is viewerPlugin.

executablePath.description: Explicit absolute drive, UNC, or Win32 extended path to an external program, or a supported macro template whose expanded value is explicit and absolute. Relative, drive-relative, rooted-without-drive, device, and bare program paths are preserved but forced disabled; launch planning validates the expanded value again.

arguments.description: External program arguments. Macro tokens {Path}, {FullPath}, {PathAndFilename}, {Filename}, {SelectedPathsFile}, {OppositePanePath}, and {ComputerName} are allowed; macro values are quoted and escaped as Windows command-line arguments.

workingDirectory.description: External program working directory. Macro tokens {Path}, {FullPath}, {PathAndFilename}, {Filename}, {SelectedPathsFile}, {OppositePanePath}, and {ComputerName} are allowed and expand as raw text.

fileActionId.title: File Action ID
fileActionId.description: Stable action identifier that preserves configured casing, but matches and uniqueness are case-insensitive. IDs that differ only by case are invalid duplicates.

openWithFileSystemByExtension.title: File System by Extension
openWithFileSystemByExtension.description: Maps a file extension (lowercase, with leading dot like ".7z") to a virtual file system plugin ID.

pluginsSettings.title: Plugins
pluginsSettings.description: Plugin manager settings (enabled/disabled plugins, custom plugin paths, and per-plugin configuration).

customPluginPaths.title: Custom Plugin Paths
customPluginPaths.description: Absolute paths to custom plugin DLLs (outside the application folder).

disabledPluginIds.title: Disabled Plugins
disabledPluginIds.description: Plugin IDs disabled by the user.

configurationByPluginId.title: Plugin Configuration
configurationByPluginId.description: Per-plugin configuration objects keyed by plugin ID.

themeColorSource.title: Theme Color Source
themeColorSource.description: A direct hex color or a version 2 theme expression.

themeId.title: Theme Id
themeId.description: Builtin theme id (builtin/*) or user theme id (user/*).

themeDefinition.title: Theme Definition
themeDefinition.description: A version 2 user-defined theme with authored palette entries and semantic color sources.

formatVersion.title: Theme Format Version
formatVersion.description: Required version of the expressive theme format.

id.title: Id
id.description: Unique theme id (must start with user/).

baseThemeId.title: Base Theme
baseThemeId.description: Builtin theme used as a base for this theme.

palette.title: Palette
palette.description: Reusable authored color sources. Palette names are case-sensitive and cannot contain a dot.

colors.title: Color Overrides
colors.description: Map of semantic color keys to direct colors or version 2 expressions.

themeSettings.title: Theme
themeSettings.description: Theme selection and user theme definitions.

themes.title: Themes
themes.description: User theme definitions stored in settings.

folderSortBy.title: Sort By
folderSortBy.description: Primary sort key for folder items.

folderViewSettings.title: Folder View
folderViewSettings.description: Folder pane view settings (display mode, sorting, and pane chrome visibility).

display.title: Display
display.description: Brief, detailed, extra-detailed, or thumbnails view.

fileExtensionsVisible.title: File Extensions
fileExtensionsVisible.description: Whether file extensions are shown in pane item labels. This is display-only; file operations still use real names.

thumbnailSizeDip.title: Thumbnail Size
thumbnailSizeDip.description: Per-pane thumbnail size in device-independent pixels.

thumbnailsVisible.title: Legacy Thumbnails
thumbnailsVisible.description: Deprecated compatibility flag. Readers treat true as display=thumbnails; writers persist thumbnails through view.display instead.

navigationBarVisible.title: Navigation Bar
navigationBarVisible.description: Whether the pane navigation/address bar is visible.

filterBarVisible.title: Filter Bar
filterBarVisible.description: Whether the persistent pane filter-state bar is visible.

statusBarVisible.title: Status Bar
statusBarVisible.description: Whether the status bar is visible.

foldersSettings.title: Folders
foldersSettings.description: Folders pane settings (active pane, view defaults, layout, and history).

showHiddenFiles.title: Display hidden files and folders
showHiddenFiles.description: Whether hidden files and folders are displayed in folder panes.

showSystemFiles.title: Display system files and folders
showSystemFiles.description: Whether system files and folders are displayed in folder panes.

historyMax.title: History Size
historyMax.description: Maximum number of folders kept in history.

directoryInfoCacheSettings.title: Directory Info Cache
directoryInfoCacheSettings.description: Cache limits and watcher settings for directory info.

maxBytes.title: Max Bytes
maxBytes.description: Maximum size of the directory info cache (accepts integer KiB or a string like '256 MB').

maxWatchers.title: Max Watchers
maxWatchers.description: Maximum number of folder watchers used by the cache.

mruWatched.title: MRU Watched
mruWatched.description: Maximum number of recently watched folders stored in the cache.

fileOperationsSettings.title: File Operations
fileOperationsSettings.description: Global file operation behavior and diagnostics retention settings.

autoDismissSuccess.title: Auto-dismiss Success
autoDismissSuccess.description: Automatically dismiss completed successful file-operation tasks.

popupFooterOnly.title: Footer-only Popup
popupFooterOnly.description: Collapse the file-operations popup to the aggregate footer until details are shown again.

popupCompactDensity.title: Compact Popup Density
popupCompactDensity.description: Render file-operation popup cards as compact one-line rows until expanded density is restored.

preCalcEnabled.title: Enable Pre-calculation
preCalcEnabled.description: Run the recursive pre-calculation pass before copy, move, and permanent delete operations when that operation type supports it.

preCalcMaxWorkers.title: Pre-calculation Workers
preCalcMaxWorkers.description: Maximum worker count for the pre-calculation tree walk. Higher values can improve throughput when many top-level sources are scanned in parallel.

crossFsBridgeBufferSizeKB.title: Cross-FS Bridge Buffer (KB)
crossFsBridgeBufferSizeKB.description: Per-buffer size for host-side cross-filesystem bridge copies. Two buffers are allocated per active bridged file transfer.

defaultBandwidthLimitBytesPerSecond.title: Default Bandwidth Limit (B/s)
defaultBandwidthLimitBytesPerSecond.description: Default speed limit applied to newly created copy and move tasks. A value of 0 leaves new tasks unlimited until the user changes the limit in the progress popup.

maxDiagnosticsLogFiles.title: Max Diagnostics Log Files
maxDiagnosticsLogFiles.description: Maximum number of file-operation diagnostics log files kept on disk.

diagnosticsInfoEnabled.title: Diagnostics: Info
diagnosticsInfoEnabled.description: Include info-level file-operation diagnostics in the per-day diagnostics log (Debug builds default to true; Release builds default to false).

diagnosticsDebugEnabled.title: Diagnostics: Debug
diagnosticsDebugEnabled.description: Include debug-level file-operation diagnostics in the per-day diagnostics log (Debug builds default to true; Release builds default to false).

maxIssueReportFiles.title: Max Issue Report Files
maxIssueReportFiles.description: Maximum number of exported file-operation issue reports kept on disk (advanced JSON-only setting).

maxDiagnosticsInMemory.title: Max Diagnostics In Memory
maxDiagnosticsInMemory.description: Maximum number of diagnostics entries retained in memory (advanced JSON-only setting).

maxDiagnosticsPerFlush.title: Max Diagnostics Per Flush
maxDiagnosticsPerFlush.description: Minimum pending diagnostics batch threshold before periodic flush (advanced JSON-only setting).

diagnosticsFlushIntervalMs.title: Diagnostics Flush Interval (ms)
diagnosticsFlushIntervalMs.description: Periodic diagnostics flush interval in milliseconds (advanced JSON-only setting).

diagnosticsCleanupIntervalMs.title: Diagnostics Cleanup Interval (ms)
diagnosticsCleanupIntervalMs.description: Interval between diagnostics log cleanup passes in milliseconds (advanced JSON-only setting).

compareDirectoriesSettings.title: Compare Directories
compareDirectoriesSettings.description: Settings for the Compare Directories command.

contentCompareWorkerCount.title: Content Compare Workers
contentCompareWorkerCount.description: 0 = auto (clamped to <= 4), 1..4 = fixed worker count for background content compare.

keepIdenticalItems.title: Keep Identical Items
keepIdenticalItems.description: Retain identical entries so the 'Show Identical Items' view toggle is available. Uses more memory on very large trees.

showIdenticalItems.title: Show Identical Items
showIdenticalItems.description: Show identical items (not just differences) by default. Requires keepIdenticalItems.

hotPathSlot.title: Hot Path Slot
hotPathSlot.description: A single hot path bookmark slot.

path.title: Path
path.description: The folder path for this hot path.

label.title: Label
label.description: Optional display name. If empty, the path is shown.

showInMenu.title: Show in Menu
showInMenu.description: Show this hot path in the Change Drive popup menu.

hotPathsSettings.title: Hot Paths
hotPathsSettings.description: Bookmark slots for quick folder navigation (Ctrl+1..Ctrl+0).

openPrefsOnAssign.title: Open Preferences on Assign
openPrefsOnAssign.description: Open the Hot Paths preferences page after assigning a slot.

slots.title: Slots
slots.description: Array of 10 hot path slots (index 0 = Ctrl+1, index 9 = Ctrl+0). Null entries are empty.

selectHistory.title: Select History
selectHistory.description: Most-recent-first mask history for the Select dialog.

unselectHistory.title: Unselect History
unselectHistory.description: Most-recent-first mask history for the Unselect dialog.

filterHistory.title: Filter History
filterHistory.description: Most-recent-first mask history for the Filter dialog.

monitorMenuState.title: Monitor Menu
monitorMenuState.description: UI state for the Monitor window.

toolbarVisible.title: Toolbar
toolbarVisible.description: Show or hide the Monitor toolbar.

lineNumbersVisible.title: Line Numbers
lineNumbersVisible.description: Show or hide line numbers in the Monitor.

alwaysOnTop.title: Always On Top
alwaysOnTop.description: Keep the Monitor window above other windows.

showIds.title: Show Ids
showIds.description: Show numeric ids for messages (useful for debugging).

autoScroll.title: Auto Scroll
autoScroll.description: Scroll automatically as new messages arrive.

monitorFilterPreset.title: Monitor Filter Preset
monitorFilterPreset.description: Named preset describing which message types are shown.

mainMenuSettings.title: Main Menu
mainMenuSettings.description: Main menu and function bar visibility settings.

menuBarVisible.title: Menu Bar
menuBarVisible.description: Show or hide the main menu bar.

functionBarVisible.title: Function Bar
functionBarVisible.description: Show or hide the function bar.

showSplash.title: Splash screen
showSplash.description: Show a splash screen when startup takes longer than 300ms.

uiSettings.title: UI
uiSettings.description: App-wide DxUI behavior and chrome preferences.

compactMode.title: Compact mode
compactMode.description: Use compact spacing and control density on supported DxUI surfaces.

reducedMotion.description: Choose whether DxUI motion follows the OS setting, stays reduced, or stays fully animated.

windowBackdrop.description: Choose the DWM system backdrop policy for supported top-level app windows.

language.title: Language
language.description: Application language. Use system to follow the Windows display language.

connectionProfile.title: Connection Profile
connectionProfile.description: A single saved remote connection (non-secret fields only).

id.title: Id
id.description: Stable, unique, lowercase canonical GUID (used for WinCred storage; not used for /@conn: navigation).

requireWindowsHello.title: Require Windows Hello
requireWindowsHello.description: Hidden expert setting; when true, Windows Hello verification is required before secrets are released.

extra.title: Extra
extra.description: Plugin-specific non-secret fields. Known keys: sshPrivateKey, sshKnownHosts (SFTP/SCP); ignoreSslTrust (IMAP); copyMoveMaxConcurrency, deleteMaxConcurrency (global per connection profile).

copyMoveMaxConcurrency.description: 0 = inherit plugin setting; global per connection profile.

deleteMaxConcurrency.description: 0 = inherit plugin setting; global per connection profile.

connectionsSettings.title: Connections
connectionsSettings.description: Saved connections managed by Connection Manager.

bypassWindowsHello.title: Skip Windows Hello verification
bypassWindowsHello.description: When true, Windows Hello verification is skipped even if a connection profile requires it. Intended for automation.

allowInsecureTlsInAutomation.title: Allow insecure TLS in automation
allowInsecureTlsInAutomation.description: When true, TLS certificate validation may be relaxed for connection profiles during automated runs. Intended for automation only; leave disabled for normal interactive use.

windowsHelloReauthTimeoutMinute.title: Windows Hello Reauth Timeout (minutes)
windowsHelloReauthTimeoutMinute.description: How long recent interactive authentication is reused for a given connection (Windows Hello verification or user-entered secret). For long-running background operations (copy/compare), the host reuses successful interactive authentication for the remainder of the app run to avoid mid-operation prompts. 0 = re-ask every time.
